messages:
Noah: Quick weekend check 1 1 indie screening at Castro Sat 7:00pm (doors 6:30) or sunset bike loop + street tacos at the pier around 6pm? which vibes? :popcorn::bike::taco:
Sophie: bike + tacos for me. love the pier at golden hour. can bring a lock and a tarp to sit on.
Carlos: indee the indie screening looks good. i've been wanting to see that director's new short. but tacos are tempting.
Maya: either works. if movie, can someone grab the cheap student tickets? if bike, i need a helmet loan.
Noah: Student discount is 40% Wed-Fri only sadly. Castro gives weekend matinee pricing though.
Sophie: heads up — there's a night market on the pier Sat until 9pm. could be crowded but also more food stalls.
ops-bot: City notice: Weekend street fair on 5th Ave Sat 5-10pm may affect bike lanes and parking near the pier. Consider alternate route or secure parking.
Carlos: good to know. option: movie first then late tacos? but theater ends ~9:30 so pier vendors might close.
Maya: vote time 1 reply with "movie" or "bike"
Noah: movie
Sophie: bike
Carlos: movie
Maya: bike
Noah: tally 2 movie / 2 bike 1 toss-up.
Sophie: i'm leaning bike if we can leave early and avoid the street fair crowd.
Carlos: i'm the tiebreaker. i'll go bike if someone will promise a good playlist and not make me run up hills.
Maya: i can handle the playlist and hill pace is chill, promise.
Noah: if it's bike i'll bring lights and a small first-aid kit. if movie i'll grab two tickets and meet at 6:20.
Sophie: ok bike wins by consensus. meet at Valencia & 18th bike rack 5:40pm, roll at 6pm. taco plan: Pier Vendor Row, split payment.
Carlos: sweet. thanks for being flexible. see you Saturday 1 also shoutout to @Sophie for taco recon.
Maya: song suggestions welcome. i'll make a mellow sunset mix.
ops-bot: Reminder: Please lock bikes and pack out any trash. Enjoy!
